mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 2, order_no = #{orderNo}, used_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, coupon_id, status, order_no, used_time, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, coupon_id, status, order_no, used_time, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by FROM user_coupon WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT uc.id, uc.user_id, uc.coupon_id, uc.status, uc.order_no, uc.used_time, uc.created_at, c.name AS coupon_name, c.type AS coupon_type FROM user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.created_at DESC

SELECT uc.id, uc.user_id, uc.coupon_id, uc.status, uc.order_no, uc.used_time, uc.created_at, c.name AS coupon_name, c.type AS coupon_type FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 1 AND c.status = 1 AND c.start_time <= NOW() AND c.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY uc.created_at DESC
